verses.en: I waited patiently for the LORD; and he inclined unto me, and heard my cry.
verses.sm: Tavita. Na ou matuā faatalitali lava i le ALII; ona faasaga mai ai lea o ia ia te au, ua faafofoga mai foi o ia i laʻu alaga.

verses.en: He brought me up also out of an horrible pit, out of the miry clay, and set my feet upon a rock, and established my goings.
verses.sm: Na ia aveina ae aʻu ai le lua e malaia ai, ma le mea matua palapalā; na faatuina foi oʻu vae i luga o le papa, ua faamautuina ai oʻu savali. Io 11 12 SALAMO Ua tuuina mai e ia le pese fou i lo‘u gutu,

verses.en: And he hath put a new song in my mouth, even praise unto our God: many shall see it, and fear, and shall trust in the LORD.
verses.sm: o le viiga i lo tatou Atua; e iloa ai e le toatele, e matatau foi i latou, ma latou faatuatua i le ALII. Amuia le tagata o lé faatuatua i le ALII, a e le faasaga i e faamaualuluga, ma e ua liliu ane i mea pepelo.

verses.en: Blessed is that man that maketh the LORD his trust, and respecteth not the proud, nor such as turn aside to lies.
verses.sm: Le Aw: e, loʻu Atua, e tele lava mea ua e faia, O ou vavega ma ou manatu ia te i matou, e le mafai ona laulauina atu ai ia te oe; ou te fia faailoa ma tautala i ai, a e le mafaitaulia lava.

verses.en: Many, O LORD my God, are thy wonderful works which thou hast done, and thy thoughts which are to us-ward: they cannot be reckoned up in order unto thee: if I would declare and speak of them, they are more than can be numbered.
verses.sm: E te le finagalo i le taulaga ma le taulaga i mea e ‘ai; ua elia 2 oe oʻu taliga; o le taulaga mu ma le taulaga mo le agasala e te lei fetalai mai ai. Ona ou fai ane ai lea, Faauta, ou te alu atu; ua tusia aʻu i le tusi taai, Lo'u Atua e, ou te fiafia e fai lou finagalo; o loo i totonu lava ia te au lau tulafono. Ua ou talai le amiotonu i le faapotopotoga tele; faauta, ou te lei taofia lava oʻu laugutu, le ALII e, ua e silafia lava.

verses.en: Sacrifice and offering thou didst not desire; mine ears hast thou opened: burnt offering and sin offering hast thou not required.
verses.sm: Ou te lei natia lava i lo‘u loto lau amiotonu; ua OU tauina atu lou faamaoni ma lau faaolataga; ou te lei faalilolilo lou alofa ma le mea moni mai ia te oe i le faapotopotoga tele.

verses.en: Then said I, Lo, I come: in the volume of the book it is written of me,
verses.sm: Le ALII e, ana e te taofi e oe lou alofa mutimuti vale ¡a te au; ia leoleoina pea lava aʻu e lou alofa ma lou faamaoni.

verses.en: I delight to do thy will, O my God: yea, thy law is within my heart.
verses.sm: Aua ua siosiomia aʻu i mea leaga e le mafaitaulia; ua maua mai au e au agasala,

verses.en: I have preached righteousness in the great congregation: lo, I have not refrained my lips, O LORD, thou knowest.
verses.sm: o lea ou te le mafaia ai ona vaai; ua sili ia ona tele i oʻu lauulu; ua matua faavaivai ai lo’u loto. Le ALI e, ia e finagalo e laveai mai ia te au; le ALII e, ia vave ona e fesoasoani mai ia te au. 15 16

verses.en: I have not hid thy righteousness within my heart; I have declared thy faithfulness and thy salvation: I have not concealed thy lovingkindness and thy truth from the great congregation.
verses.sm: SALAMO 40,41 la taufaimama ma ja masiasi faatasi e ua fia fasioti ia te au;

verses.en: Withhold not thou thy tender mercies from me, O LORD: let thy lovingkindness and thy truth continually preserve me.
verses.sm: ia liutuaina ma faamaina e ua mananao i se mea ia leaga ai aʻu.

verses.en: For innumerable evils have compassed me about: mine iniquities have taken hold upon me, so that I am not able to look up; they are more than the hairs of mine head: therefore my heart faileth me.
verses.sm: la fememeai ona o lo latou má o e fai mai ia te au, Ue! ue! la olioli ma fiafia ja te oe o i

verses.en: Be pleased, O LORD, to deliver me: O LORD, make haste to help me.
verses.sm: latou uma o e sailiili ja te oe;

verses.en: Let them be ashamed and confounded together that seek after my soul to destroy it; let them be driven backward and put to shame that wish me evil.
verses.sm: ia fai ane pea i latou o e fiafia i lau faaolataga, la viia ie ALII.

verses.en: Let them be desolate for a reward of their shame that say unto me, Aha, aha.
verses.sm: A o aʻu nei, ua ou puapuagatia ma ou mativa;

verses.en: Let all those that seek thee rejoice and be glad in thee: let such as love thy salvation say continually, The LORD be magnified.
verses.sm: e manatua mai aʻu e le AW; o oe lava loʻu fesoasoani ma loʻu faaola;

verses.en: But I am poor and needy; yet the Lord thinketh upon me: thou art my help and my deliverer; make no tarrying, O my God.
verses.sm: loʻu Atua e, aua lava e te tuai mai.
